live_wiki_extracts.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
live_wiki_extracts.clean_extract: Grand Theft Auto VI (also known as Grand Theft Auto 6, GTA 6 or GTA VI) is the seventeenth and latest installment in the Grand Theft Auto series and the seventh title in the HD Universe. It was released on November 19, 2026, published by Rockstar Games. A PC release date has yet to be confirmed. During Take-Two Interactive's annual shareholder meeting on September 17, 2026, CEO Strauss Zelnick stated that "the PC platform is becoming more and more important to our company over time" when discussing the company's strategy for PC releases. Currently, the game only has single-player, and any news of any multiplayer modes or a successor to GTA Online is yet to be revealed.

live_wiki_extracts.title: Jason Duval
live_wiki_extracts.clean_extract: Jason Duval is one of the two protagonists, along with Lucia Caminos, and a playable character in . Jason has a son with Lucia named Tomás. Jason is also a native of the State of Leonida, who assists drug runners and does side jobs across the state. Living in a tropical stilt house in Key Lento, he decides to make an income with Lucia and other characters transitioning to the criminal underworld, hoping it will provide them a fulfilling lifestyle. He is an associate of Brian Heder and best friend of Cal Hampton. He is portrayed by Dylan Rourke.

live_wiki_extracts.title: Lucia Caminos
live_wiki_extracts.clean_extract: Lucia Caminos is one of the two protagonists, along with Jason Duval, and a playable character in Grand Theft Auto VI. Lucia has a son with Jason named Tomás. Struggling to raise the money needed to raise and feed her child growing up, Lucia and Jason have turned to the criminal underworld amid financial hardship and AI taking jobs in the 2020s. At the age of 26, Lucia's desperate financial situation motivated her to rob a payday loan store, and she was sentenced to 3 years at Hamlet Correctional Facility. Luck got Lucia out of prison earlier, but she is not as reformed as the state believes. She is portrayed by Manni L. Perez.

live_wiki_extracts.title: Missions in Grand Theft Auto VI
live_wiki_extracts.clean_extract: The following is a list of missions featured in . The game's storyline follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos as they become involved in criminal activities throughout the State of Leonida. The main storyline is divided into five chapters, beginning with a prologue that introduces the protagonists and their relationship. Some missions can be completed in different orders, while others become available only after certain story events. This article lists the main storyline missions in their approximate order of progression.

live_wiki_extracts.title: Radio Stations
live_wiki_extracts.clean_extract: A radio station is a broadcasting service that can be listened to in a vehicle or on a standalone radio player. They feature in every Grand Theft Auto game, and are accessible from almost any vehicle (except some such as bikes or emergency vehicles). Most radio stations play songs with a and commercials between them; other stations are primarily discussion-based. Emergency services channels are not considered radio stations. Emergency vehicles do not play public radio, except in multiplayer. Each radio station focuses on one theme or . Some PC versions have the functionality for Custom Radio Stations. Rockstar Games has with playlists for most radio stations from each GTA game, although some playlists are missing certain songs.
